recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-16894 unless the work group separately decides to maintain a comprehensive grouping-resource catalog.
issue_request: FHIR-16894 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 after a ballot comment observed that the Bundle boundaries section listed List, Group, and Composition as grouping resources but omitted other grouping mechanisms such as CareTeam and DocumentManifest. The accepted resolution was to indicate that the list is not exhaustive.
initial_application: Git history directly applies the issue in 7b9cb0c7cff88bdf34b84ed4f74e52b8a74205e7, whose GF#16894 message and git-svn revision 14362 match the Jira comment. That commit added the non-exhaustive statement, and later typo cleanup commits c3155bc601c17a8d7a5a272d31b562091699fd53 and 14537b3d6fc2504ae41c2de6340f30ceb69e9bac corrected the introduced wording errors while preserving the intended statement.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/bundle/bundle-introduction.xml is in current build scope. Current source still lists List, Group, and Composition and immediately states that the list is not exhaustive and other resources also provide grouping functionality. A later FHIR-17036 reconciliation edited adjacent Composition wording on the same page without changing the FHIR-16894 sentence, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active source already conveys the accepted FHIR-16894 resolution. Expanding the page into a comprehensive list of grouping resources would exceed the accepted resolution and risk a stale catalog.

related_jiras.note: A later reconciliation commit edited adjacent Composition wording in the same Bundle boundaries paragraph and preserved the FHIR-16894 non-exhaustive statement.
